summary: SiteDocument is a data model representing a document associated with a site, primarily storing IDs linking it to a site.
purpose: To represent and link documents to specific sites within the application.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides staff administrators with a homepage view, including login information, error/warning handling, and filters for site, discipline, and date. Users can view, filter, and interact with employment applications.
purpose: To offer an administrative dashboard for staff to review and manage employment applications and see relevant system messages.

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: Load dashboard, display welcome and last login info.
Choose site and discipline from dropdowns.
Click refresh or change filter; system binds filtered data to GridView.
Review applications, including status, email, site, and program information.

business_rules: Start date is required; validated by RequiredFieldValidator.
End date is required; validated by RequiredFieldValidator.
Dates must match regular expressions for valid format.
End date cannot precede start date; custom validator logic.
validations: CustomValidator to ensure start date <= end date.
conditions: If SiteID is not provided, show all sites for agency; otherwise, default to provided site.
If user session is missing, data retrieval is cancelled.
system_behavior: On page load, setup user context and JavaScript.
Show error and warning panels as needed.
GridView displays filtered applications with paging (PageSize = 50).
Email link setup: If email missing, no icon; otherwise, creates mailto link.
exceptions: If user session is missing, data retrieval is cancelled.
If dates are invalid, error displayed.

summary: ServiceCode is a model for representing service codes with attributes for identification, naming, categorization, ordering, notes, and localization.
purpose: To provide structured representation and retrieval of service codes and their options for courses/timetables.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll procedure with SessionID to get all codes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID to get code options.

business_rules: If alternate language mode is enabled, use alt fields for name/notes.
conditions: If Sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate texts.
system_behavior: Procedure calls for list retrieval; localization logic applied per session language.

summary: SiteProfileHistory logs changes to site profiles, capturing actions, sections, user details, agency info, and supports localization.
purpose: To track and audit changes to site profiles, including who made the change, what was changed, and when.

workflows.name: Site Profile Audit Trail
steps: User or admin modifies a site profile.
SiteProfileHistory records action, section, fields changed, user and agency info.
System provides formatted audit info (e.g., agency/user details, date, phone).

business_rules: If alternate language mode, use alternate fields for screen section, action, and fields.
conditions: If user is not sys admin and user IDs differ, prepend 'HSPnet Support Team' caption.
system_behavior: Audit entries are constructed and formatted for clarity, including tooltips and formatted names.

summary: EmailPopupDocument models a document for email popups, including file info and logic for searching and deleting files based on user actions.
purpose: To manage email-related files, allowing searching and deletion of documents presented in email popups.

workflows.name: Search and Delete EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Parse DataInfo string to retrieve document objects.
Present user with file list for selection.
When user deletes, remove file and folder, update list as needed.

business_rules: Only valid dataInfo entries (with > separator and two fields) are considered.
On delete, file and containing folder are removed if possible.
conditions: If DataInfo is empty, no documents returned or deleted.
system_behavior: Handles searching and deletion via string parsing and file operations.
exceptions: If file/folder deletion fails, operation is silently ignored.
